title: Spectral Pricing of Corridor Products under Layered Local Volatility
abstract: arXiv:2611.23587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We price corridor products under a $N$-layered local volatility, piecewise constant in the price and in time, with knock-out barriers. A spatial scale transformation and the GIT method reduce the killed Green's function to a symmetric tridiagonal system of fixed size $N-1$. With equal scaled layer widths the spectrum follows from one tridiagonal eigen-decomposition together with the explicit eigenfunctions that vanish at every interface. For general scaled layer widths an exact counting theorem locates every eigenvalue. Consecutive time intervals of constant volatility are connected by a matrix that re-expands the solution in the eigenbasis of the preceding interval, and the result converges exponentially in the number of retained terms in the eigenfunction expansion. translated_title: 分层局部波动率下走廊类产品的谱方法定价
translated_abstract: 我们在 $N$ 层局部波动率（在价格和时间维度上均为分段常数）框架下，对带有敲出障碍的走廊类产品进行定价。通过空间尺度变换和 GIT 方法，将被吸收的格林函数约化为一个固定规模为 $N-1$ 的对称三对角系统。当各层的缩放宽度相等时，谱可通过一次三对角特征值分解以及在每个界面处为零的显式特征函数得到。对于一般的缩放层宽，一个精确计数定理可定位每一个特征值。相邻的常波动率时间区间通过一个矩阵相连接，该矩阵将解在前一区间的特征基下重新展开，结果在特征函数展开保留项数上呈指数收敛。允许吸收率在不同层之间变化仍可保持这一构造。在单个时间区间上，走廊累积分布随后可通过求逆……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种谱定价框架，将带敲出障碍的 $N$ 层分段常数局部波动率下走廊类产品的定价约化为固定规模的对称三对角特征值问题，并借助矩阵实现跨时间区间的连接，使计算在特征函数展开项数上呈指数收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a spectral pricing framework that reduces the valuation of corridor products with knock-out barriers under $N$-layered piecewise-constant local volatility to a fixed-size symmetric tridiagonal eigenproblem, with matrix-based connections across time intervals yielding exponential convergence in the number of retained eigenfunction terms.
